transcript: Rainy Monday. Missed the bus so I walked to work and my umbrella flipped inside out twice. Stopped at the little coffee place on Valencia and the barista drew a cat in my latte. Whole afternoon was meetings, then I cooked ramen at home and listened to the rain on the skylight.

spec.moment: Stopping at the little coffee shop on Valencia where the barista drew a cat in the latte foam.

elements.name: latte with foam cat
elements.look: a wide ceramic mug holding a warm latte topped with delicate cat face foam art

elements.name: flipped umbrella
elements.look: a dark rain umbrella blown inside out, resting wet against a chair leg

elements.name: coffee shop counter
elements.look: a warm wooden cafe counter with steam rising from a shiny espresso machine

elements.name: barista
elements.look: a figure in a deep green apron standing behind the counter

spec.scene: A warm wooden cafe floor with wet footprints leading from the doorway. At center, an oversized ceramic cup sits on a small round bistro table, filled with milky coffee and foam shaped into a tiny cat face. Leaning against the table leg lies a dark umbrella, blown inside out with glistening rain droplets on its fabric. At the back edge stands a slice of wooden counter with a barista in a dark green apron beside a silver espresso machine. Soft amber light glows from an overhead pendant lamp.
spec.title: A Cat in the Foam
spec.caption: The barista drew a cat in my latte after the wind wrecked my umbrella.
